chunks: Then all news will be blacked out for them, and they will not even ask one another.

key_terms.يَوْمَئِذٍ: on that day (referring to the Day of Judgment)

ai.seo_question: What happens to the disbelievers' perception and speech on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the psychological paralysis of the disbelievers, where the overwhelming reality of divine justice renders them mute and unable to seek clarification from one another. This silence signifies the finality of their judgment, contrasting with the active inquiry of the righteous, and underscores the consequence of their prior rejection of clear signs.
